_comment: Seed ASNs for RFC 9092 geofeed discovery. These are SEEDS, not a URL list:
the geofeed URL (if any) is read out of RIR whois at run time, so a provider
that starts publishing one is picked up without a code change.
Adding a provider here does NOT make its ranges count as customer compute -
discovered geofeeds are classified 'unknown' until a reviewed edit to
